title_tr: Okundu işaretlenen bildirim, okunmamış sayısını azaltmıyor
issue: After a user marks a notification as read, their unread notification count stays the same. The count (and the unread list) should only include notifications that have not been read.

bug.find: return [n for n in self.for_user(user_id) if not n.read]

ground_truth.root_cause: NotificationService.unread returns every notification of the user without filtering out read ones; unread_count is derived from it, so it never decreases.
ground_truth.fix: Filter the list in unread(): [n for n in self.for_user(user_id) if not n.read].
